lineage: Infrastructure seized by FBI/international partners in January 2023; Hive's codebase is widely reported to have been acquired by Hunters International (active 2023-2025, later World Leaks)
summary: Hive was a RaaS active from June 2021 that hit 1,500+ victims, notably hospitals, before an FBI infiltration and takedown in January 2023. Affiliates (including Microsoft-tracked DEV-0237/Pistachio Tempest) gained access via single-factor RDP/VPN, FortiOS MFA-bypass and Exchange ProxyShell, then used Cobalt Strike, Mimikatz and pass-the-hash to own the domain within ~72 hours. Hive exfiltrated with Rclone/MEGA and deployed Go- and later Rust-based encryptors for Windows, Linux and VMware ESXi.
uniqueTraits: Exploited FortiOS CVE-2020-12812 to bypass FortiToken second-factor authentication
Exchange ProxyShell web shells running SYSTEM-level PowerShell that staged Cobalt Strike in memory
Batch scripts hive.bat / shadow.bat that delete shadow copies and then delete themselves
Dedicated Esxi_encrypt / Linux_encrypt variants; Rust rewrite (2022) storing keys in *.key files at drive root
